data.name: Mandated Fate
data.detailed_description:
Mandated Fate is a narrative-driven social thriller where loyalty is survival. You play as a weary inspector, a man with a fraught past, out of place in a newly established authoritarian regime.

In 1985, a rising technological empire has seized power, driven by a single ambition: to discover the anti-gravity particle and surpass its global rivals by conquering space. The regime demands absolute unity, framing this race as a matter of national destiny. But one old district continues to resist, no one knows quite how, or why.

Assigned to investigate a strange murder there, you quickly find yourself entangled in a deeper web of political intrigue and ideological tension - balancing your loyalty and your life to save what truly matters before the city closes in.

Your choices will shape your loyalties, and determine your path.

1st AND 3rd person camera available

MAINTAIN YOUR SOCIAL STANDING

You are tasked with a dangerous investigation where crossing into illegality isn't just easy-it's expected. Your mission? Uphold the law by breaking it. The Empire demands absolute results and absolute loyalty, even when they contradict each other. But don't worry, the Emperor is a generous man; he knows exactly how to reward citizens who... cooperate. Loyal, unaligned, or dissident, your choices will lead you down different paths. Choose your answers carefully, or live with the consequences of your choices.

RISK EVERYTHING TO UNCOVER THE TRUTH

Interrogate key characters through a rich and complex dialogue system, where storytelling takes center stage. Gather clues from hidden documents, consult them on your computer, and read between the lines. Some secrets are best left undisturbed, especially when the government is involved. Investigate, but know when to stop; the Emperor wants no answers, he wants silence!

FACE THE CONSEQUENCES

You'll make choices you’ll have to live with. If your loyalty fails, you’ll be forced into brutal moral trade-offs. Betray your neighbors, bribe the guards, or sacrifice your allies to buy your way out.

EXPLORE AND IMMERSE YOURSELF

A city with an intense and overwhelming atmosphere, characterized by a strong sense of verticality. Explore the streets and building interiors without any loading times. Walk, take the subway, the elevator, drive: But beware, government surveillance is never far away! Your driving will be closely monitored. Experience a world of haunting contrasts, where narrow, dark alleyways meet gargantuan structures, and elegant Art Deco ruins stand in the shadow of authoritarian neo-brutalism and towering screens.

HOW DOES THE CORE LOOP EVOLVE?

The core loop evolves through the tension between your public Merit Score (Imperial metric) and your private Convictions.

  • The Loop: maintain status and make choices through dialogues, investigate situations/collect intel, face the consequences of your choices (with multiple supporting systems and exploration)

  • The Evolution: As the story progresses, your Conviction acts as a form of Ideological Charisma. Early on, you’re just a face in the crowd. But as you solidify your stance (Pro-Empire or Dissident), you become more 'authentic' and convincing to like-minded NPCs.

  • The Payoff: This authenticity unlocks deeper secrets, hidden paths, and high-stakes dialogue options that a 'neutral' player would never see. You’ll start by simply trying to survive the system, but you’ll end up either mastering its bureaucracy or subverting it from the shadows

FEATURES

  • Face truly critical choices from the very beginning: decisions that will have a significant impact on the story.

  • Experience seamless, multi-level building interiors exploration through richly detailed streets and fully integrated, loading-free interiors.

  • Deep and complex dialogues that shape interactions and outcomes.

  • A dark and captivating atmosphere inspired by neo-noir and cyberpunk aesthetics.

  • A fully functional subway system integrated into the game world.

Narrative structure:

Mandated Fate’s stories are built around overlapping motives: government-level agendas, personal stakes, and moral dilemmas. The result is outcomes where ambiguity often remains central.

data.short_description: A dystopian future-noir social thriller. As an Imperial Inspector, navigate a towering technocratic empire where loyalty is survival. Investigate secrets, manipulate factions, and make brutal moral choices. In this alternate history, will you uphold the regime or subvert the truth?

content_descriptors.notes: This game features a fictional autocratic government that enforces totalitarian laws and a strict police presence. This government and all characters associated with it are entirely fictional. Alcohol and tobacco are rarely present but may occasionally appear on screen. Strong language is also rare but may be used by certain characters.
